result.keyword: Who are the best personal injury lawyers in Newcastle?
result.markdown:
Assuming you mean **Newcastle, NSW**, I’d shortlist these firms. There isn’t an objective “best” lawyer, so I’ve weighted **personal-injury specialisation, professional standing, local presence, and current client ratings** rather than simply picking the firms with the most Google reviews.

### My top Newcastle picks

**1. Burke Mead Lawyers — my strongest overall pick**  
Burke Mead Lawyers - Newcastle
Burke Mead Lawyers - Newcastle
[Web](https://www.burkemeadlawyers.com.au/?utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=gmb-listing&utm_term=newcastle&utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Address: level 4/21 Bolton St, Newcastle NSW 2300, Australia
Phone: +61249023800

- Dedicated personal-injury practice covering **workers compensation, motor-vehicle accidents, public liability, medical negligence, superannuation/TPD and abuse claims**. [www.burkemeadlawyers.com.au](https://www.burkemeadlawyers.com.au/offices/newcastle/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- **Emma Mead is a Law Society of NSW Accredited Specialist in Personal Injury Law** and practises exclusively in personal injury. [www.burkemeadlawyers.com.au](https://www.burkemeadlawyers.com.au/team/emma-mead/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- The firm currently lists multiple **2026 Doyle's Guide** recognitions, including Preeminent Lawyer for Motor Vehicle Accident Compensation and Work Injury Compensation. [www.burkemeadlawyers.com.au](https://www.burkemeadlawyers.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Strong local reviews: **4.8/5 from 93 reviews** in the current business listing.
- The Newcastle Law Society also lists Emma Mead as a senior **Personal Injury** mentor. [newcastlelawsociety.com.au](https://newcastlelawsociety.com.au/our-mentors/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**2. Carroll & O'Dea Lawyers — particularly worth considering for complex injury claims**  
Carroll & O'Dea Lawyers
Carroll & O'Dea Lawyers
[Web](http://www.codea.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Address: Level 5/384 Hunter St, Newcastle NSW 2300, Australia
Phone: +61240321700

- Newcastle office specifically categorised as a personal-injury practice.
- **David Jones**, a Newcastle Law Society senior mentor, is listed under **Personal Injury** at Carroll & O'Dea. [newcastlelawsociety.com.au](https://newcastlelawsociety.com.au/our-mentors/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Current local rating is **4.6/5**.
- I'd put them high on the list for a substantial or complicated claim where experience with litigation matters.

**3. Shine Lawyers Newcastle — good choice for a larger specialist practice**  
Shine Lawyers Newcastle
Shine Lawyers Newcastle
[Web](https://www.shine.com.au/locations/nsw/newcastle/?utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=local-places-for-business&utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Address: 368 King St, Newcastle NSW 2300, Australia
Phone: +61240376700

- Large national compensation-law firm with a dedicated Newcastle presence.
- Current local rating is **4.6/5 from 51 reviews**.
- The Newcastle Law Society directory confirms lawyers from Shine practising locally. [newcastlelawsociety.com.au](https://newcastlelawsociety.com.au/member-directory/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
- Particularly worth comparing if your claim involves **workers compensation, motor vehicle injury or another substantial compensation claim**.

**4. Law Partners Injury Lawyers Newcastle — another strong specialist option**  
Law Partners Injury Lawyers Newcastle
Law Partners Injury Lawyers Newcastle
[Web](https://lawpartners.com.au/offices/personal-injury-lawyers-newcastle?utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=gbp-newcastle&utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Address: Ste 5.02 Level 5/400 Hunter St, Newcastle NSW 2300, Australia
Phone: +61249291153

- Dedicated personal-injury practice rather than a generalist firm.
- Current local rating is **4.6/5 from 29 reviews**.
- The Newcastle Law Society directory lists local Law Partners personal-injury practitioners. [newcastlelawsociety.com.au](https://newcastlelawsociety.com.au/member-directory-lawyer/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

**5. Walker Law Group — worth getting a quote/opinion from**  
Walker Law Group
Walker Law Group
[Web](https://www.walkerlawgroup.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)
Address: Ste 2 level 2/426 King St, Newcastle West NSW 2300, Australia
Phone: +61280469700

- Newcastle practice specifically categorised as personal injury.
- Current rating is **5.0/5 from 32 reviews**.
- I'd consider them particularly as a second opinion alongside one of the more established specialist practices.

### If it were my case

I'd probably **speak to Burke Mead first**, then get a second opinion from **Carroll & O'Dea or Shine** before formally signing anything. Burke Mead stands out because its practice is concentrated on injured plaintiffs, it has a Law Society-accredited personal-injury specialist, and it has substantial current recognition in the compensation field. [www.burkemeadlawyers.com.au](https://www.burkemeadlawyers.com.au/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

One important point: **the “best” firm depends heavily on what happened to you**. A workers-compensation claim, serious car accident, medical negligence claim, public-liability injury, and TPD claim can call for quite different expertise.

If you tell me **what type of injury/claim you have** (e.g. workplace accident, car accident, medical negligence, slip/fall, psychological injury), I can narrow this to the **3 best Newcastle lawyers for your particular case**, including their experience, reviews, fees/no-win-no-fee arrangements, and contact details.
